Deal Logic Terms of Use

Last updated 5 November 2026

1. About Deal Logic

Deal Logic is a free legal-information and transaction-planning app operated by Milo Brooks (“we”, “us”). It helps users explore mergers and acquisitions issues through questionnaires, indicative risk assessments, suggested actions, saved deal workspaces and public company information.

These terms apply to guests and account holders. You must read them before using the app. You may save or print a copy for future reference. By using Deal Logic, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, you must stop using it.

You may contact us at milobrooks100@gmail.com.

2. General information and no reliance

Deal Logic’s content and outputs are provided solely for general information. You must not rely on them as advice or as a basis for taking—or deciding not to take—any action. You must obtain appropriate professional or specialist advice before acting, or refraining from acting, on anything presented by the app.

This applies to questionnaires, risk scores, assessments, suggested actions, reports and company information. These features do not replace professional judgement or advice tailored to your circumstances and transaction. Using Deal Logic does not create a solicitor–client relationship.

Although we make reasonable efforts to maintain and update the content, we give no express or implied assurance, representation, warranty or guarantee that it is accurate, complete or current. Outputs depend on the information supplied and may omit relevant facts, legal developments or jurisdictional differences. You are responsible for checking that the jurisdiction identified for an issue is relevant to your circumstances. Risk scores are illustrative guides, not predictions or assurances of an outcome.

Nothing in this clause limits any responsibility or statutory right that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

3. Accounts and your information

You must provide accurate account information and keep your sign-in details confidential. You must notify us promptly if you suspect unauthorised access.

You must only enter information you are authorised to use. You are responsible for complying with confidentiality obligations and ensuring that any personal or sensitive information you enter is necessary and appropriate. Entering information does not itself create or preserve legal professional privilege.

You retain ownership of your content. You give us permission to store, copy and process it through our service providers as needed to operate the features you use. This permission does not authorise publication of private workspace content or its use in advertising.

Our separate Privacy Notice explains how we handle personal information, browser storage, retention and deletion.

4. Saved work and availability

You are responsible for keeping separate copies of important work. Guest progress is stored in your browser; cloud saving depends on the account and verification features described in the app.

We aim to provide a reliable service, but cannot guarantee uninterrupted access or recovery of all saved work. We may change, suspend or withdraw features for maintenance, security or other reasonable operational reasons. Where practicable, we will give advance notice of changes affecting saved work and an opportunity to copy it.

5. Permitted use and intellectual property

You may use Deal Logic for learning and your own professional or business work. You may download, adapt and share exported reports for those purposes, including with colleagues, clients and transaction advisers. You must retain relevant source acknowledgements and legal-information notices with the material.

Rights in the app’s software, branding and original content remain with their owners. Unless permitted by law or agreed with us, you must not reproduce substantial parts of the app, sell its content as a standalone product, or use its branding to suggest our endorsement.

You must not use automated tools to extract our content in bulk for republication, commercial datasets or training AI models without permission. This restriction does not prevent use of your own content, ordinary search indexing, accessibility tools, or activities that applicable law does not allow us to restrict.

6. Safe and lawful use

You must not use Deal Logic unlawfully, infringe another person’s rights, introduce harmful software, bypass access controls, or disrupt the app or its supporting services.

You are responsible for keeping your devices and software reasonably secure and up to date. Although we take reasonable care, we cannot guarantee that the app will be free from every bug or security threat.

You may link to the app fairly and lawfully. You must not imply a relationship or endorsement that does not exist, or embed the app within another service without permission.

7. External information and links

Company Radar and other external sources depend on third-party records and services. You are responsible for verifying important information against its original source before using it.

Links are provided for reference. We do not control external websites, and a link does not mean we endorse their content. Separate provider terms may apply when you use those services.

8. Restricting or ending access

You may stop using Deal Logic at any time and request account deletion as explained in the Privacy Notice.

We may remove unlawful content or restrict access where reasonably necessary to address a serious breach of these terms, a security risk or a legal requirement. Where appropriate, we will explain the reason and give you an opportunity to resolve the issue. Urgent action may be necessary before notice can be given.

Protections applying to everyone

Nothing in these terms excludes or limits liability for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, death or personal injury caused by negligence, or any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded or limited. Your statutory rights remain unaffected.

Business users

If you use Deal Logic for business or professional purposes, the following provisions apply to the extent permitted by law:

  • We exclude conditions, warranties, representations and other terms that would otherwise be implied into your use of the app or its content.
  • We accept no liability for loss or damage arising from using or being unable to use Deal Logic, or from using or relying on its content and outputs. This applies whether the claim arises under contract, negligence or another tort, breach of statutory duty, or otherwise, and whether or not the loss was foreseeable.
  • These exclusions include loss of profits, sales, business or revenue; business interruption; lost anticipated savings; loss of business opportunity, goodwill or reputation; and indirect or consequential loss or damage.

Consumer users

If you use Deal Logic as a consumer, the app is provided for personal and private use only. You agree not to use it for commercial or business purposes under these consumer provisions. Subject to any liability that cannot lawfully be excluded, we are not liable for loss of profit, loss of business, business interruption or loss of business opportunity.

10. Changes and transfer

We may update these terms to reflect changes to the app, its operation or legal requirements. We will publish the revised terms with their date and give reasonable advance notice of material changes. Changes will not remove rights relating to earlier events. Where your agreement is required, we will ask for it.

If another operator takes over Deal Logic, we may transfer these arrangements to them, provided your rights are not reduced. We will notify you and explain any relevant changes to how your information is handled.

11. Governing law and disputes

The law of England and Wales governs these terms and related disputes. Business users and we agree to resolve disputes in the courts of England and Wales.

Consumers retain any mandatory protections under the law of their place of residence and any right to bring proceedings in their local courts.

You may raise questions or complaints at milobrooks100@gmail.com, and we will try to resolve them with you.
